patthana16.85:1.1: anidassanaappaṭighaṃ pītisahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anidassanaappaṭigho na pītisahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: anidassanaappaṭighaṃ pītisahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassanasappaṭigho na pītisahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: …pe… anidassanaappaṭighaṃ pītisahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassanasappaṭigho na pītisahagato ca na anidassanasappaṭigho na pītisahagato ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā:. hetuyā cha.
patthana16.85:2.1: anidassanaappaṭighaṃ na pītisahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassanasappaṭigho na napītisahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. sanidassanattika sukhasahagataduke nasanidassanattika nasukhasahagatadukaṃ
